Supplier contract clauses.payment: The Service Provider will invoice monthly in arrears. The Authority will pay valid invoices within 30 days.
Supplier contract clauses.liability: Apart from death or personal injury caused by negligence, each party's total liability in each Contract Year is limited to 125% of the Service Charges paid or payable in that Contract Year.
Supplier contract clauses.insurance: The Service Provider will maintain public liability insurance of at least £10 million and employer's liability insurance as required by law.
Supplier contract clauses.renewal: The Authority may extend this agreement twice, each time for a further 12 months, by giving at least three months' written notice before the end of the Initial Term or of the first extension.
Supplier contract clauses.data_protection: The Service Provider will process personal data only on the Authority's written instructions.

Supplier contract risk review.overall: The contract meets every rule of the purchasing policy.
